hero.body: Daily devotionals, live prayer sessions, sermon library, Bible study tools, and more, all in one beautiful app.

features.body: We've combined every tool you need for your spiritual journey into one beautifully designed experience. No distractions, just growth.

daily.title: Daily Devotionals
daily.desc: Fresh content daily with audio readings, scripture, memory verses, and multi-language support.

streaks.title: Prayer Streaks
streaks.desc: Set daily goals, track your consistency with visual progress rings, and never break your chain of fire.

sermons.title: Sermon Library
sermons.desc: Browse by series or playlist with speed control, waveform visualization, and offline downloads.

bible.title: Bible Study
bible.desc: Multiple Bible versions, verse lookup, integrated scripture readings, and global search across resources.

prayer.title: Prayer Management
prayer.desc: Create prayer lists, set timers, enable focus mode with ambient sounds, and protect private prayers with biometrics.

study.title: Self-Study Hub
study.desc: Your notes, bookmarks, and highlights all in one place, linked to devotionals and sermons.

notifications.title: Smart Notifications
notifications.desc: Never miss a devotional or prayer time with customizable push notifications and quiet hours support.

events.title: Church Events
events.desc: Browse upcoming events, register to attend or volunteer, and get reminders for what matters.

language.title: Multi-Language
language.desc: Full app experience in English, Italian, Spanish, German, Arabic, Russian, and French. Switch languages anytime.

devotionals.body: Fresh devotional content delivered daily with beautiful cover images, audio readings, scripture passages, and memory verses to carry with you.

prayer.managementBody: Create and organize prayer lists with powerful tools designed to deepen your prayer practice.
prayer.streaksBody: Set daily devotional goals and track your consistency with beautiful visualizations.

live.body: The National Prayer Session with Pastor Jerry Eze. Join believers worldwide every weekday morning for powerful prayer.

sermons.body: Browse sermons by series or playlist. Our powerful audio player keeps you engaged with waveform visualization and seamless background playback.

tools.player: Full audio player with seek and skip

notes.title: Notes
notes.desc: Rich text notes linked to devotionals and sermons. Search, filter, and organize your thoughts.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.desc: Save your favorite devotionals and sermons for quick access anytime.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.desc: Color-coded highlighted passages from your readings, all in one searchable view.

gift.body: Sponsor someone's daily walk with God. Gift them access to the full e-devotional — fresh content every morning, audio readings, scripture, and memory verses.

targeted.desc: Send directly to someone's email. They receive a personal claim link and can activate their devotional access straight from the web.

batch.title: Gift to a group
batch.desc: Generate a shareable code link — ideal for churches, outreach programmes, and community events.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy Policy for the Streams of Joy mobile application and website.
privacy.introBody: Welcome to Streams of Joy. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and website.
privacy.personalBody: We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you register for an account, participate in activities, or contact us directly. This may include:
privacy.autoBody: When you access our Services, we automatically collect device information, usage data, and general location based on IP address.
privacy.sharingBody: We may share information with service providers, for legal obligations, during business transfers, or with your consent. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.rightsBody: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or port your data. To exercise these rights, visit our Streams of Joy Account Deletion page or contact us at privacy@streamsofjoy.com.
privacy.securityBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

terms.useBody: You agree NOT to use the Services to:

terms.donationsBody: Donations are voluntary contributions and are final and non-refundable unless required by law. Payments are processed through secure third-party processors. Recurring donations may be cancelled at any time.
terms.ipBody: The Services and their content are owned by Consonant Technologies Ltd. and protected by intellectual property laws. You are granted a limited, non-exclusive license for personal, non-commercial use.
terms.disclaimersBody: THE SERVICES ARE PROVIDED "AS IS" WITHOUT WARRANTIES OF ANY KIND. Spiritual content is for inspirational purposes only and not intended to replace professional advice.
terms.liabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the Services.
terms.terminationBody: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access at any time. You may terminate your account by contacting us or using the account deletion feature.
